entries.en: Soldier, I've got a major situation, and I need help from somebody with humanity's interests at heart.
Of course. Right to business. That's why humanity has the best damn fleet in the galaxy.
My name is Elias Keeler. I'm an Alliance negotiator. We've got a big session coming up with the salarians.
You wouldn't believe what's riding on this. I'm fighting for humanity on this one, just like you are!
I'm not on the front lines, but I'm making sure our jobs don't get outsourced to the aliens.
I need every edge I can get. Specifically, I need a certain mental stimulant.
In order to do my best for humanity, I need the best resources on the market.
There's a mental stimulant that increases alertness and cognitive function.
I need you to buy a mental stimulant for me.
It's legal but restricted. I've purchased the monthly limit, and I need more from the med bay.
The salarians want to set up long-term trade agreements. There are billions of credits at stake.
If I don't get the drug, my assistant will take over and mess up the whole deal. It would be a disaster.
I don't know the medical terms, but it increases mental capacity, short-term recall, that sort of thing.
The negotiations were supposed to be last week, but the salarians stalled it, probably deliberately.
If I don't get the stimulant, I'll be a wreck. My assistant will take over, and that would be a disaster.
I understand. I'll pay you back for it, and I can even throw in a little extra.
Thanks for your help. Like I said, you can find the stimulant over in the med bay.
What century are you living in? Do you think those salarians hesitate before amping themselves up?
If you won't help me keep humanity strong, I'll find somebody else who will!
Perfect. The salarians will never see me coming. Here. This is for your trouble.
What is... this isn't the stimulant! What did you give me?
It's commander, actually. What do you want?
What kind of situation are we talking about?
I don't remember seeing you hip-deep in geth back on Eden Prime.
I understand. It's important. So what do you need?
Don't try to sell me on this. Just tell me what you want.
Why is this deal so important?
What is this stimulant, exactly?
If you know the monthly limits, why did you go over them?
Is your assistant incompetent or just inexperienced?
I'll see what I can do, but I can't guarantee anything.
Here's the drug you asked for.
Here. This should take care of all your problems.
I'm not just a soldier.
You're a pencil-pusher.
I get it.
Cut the act.
The negotiation
The drug
Drug dosage
(Give him the stimulant.)
(Give him the depressant.)
What's wrong with him?
If you've gotten your temper back under control, I could still use help.
I tell you what: this will be the last time I use the stimulant. After this deal is finished, I'll get treatment.
You don't understand! Humanity needs me, and I need that stimulant! Without it, I'll...
I don't know anymore. I get so tired when I run out of the stimulant. I just need one more boost.
You're right. I-- I'll go tell my assistant. I shouldn't be working like this.
I'll get help. I'm just sorry it came to this.
As we agreed, I'll get treatment when the deal is done. Thank you for your help.
Thanks for your help. I won't trouble you again.
You bastard... You... set me up...
Alien... loving... scum...
Any luck getting what I asked for?
It helps me stay focused, and it keeps me sharp. Nothing gets by me when I'm on it.
Worse. He's an alien sympathizer.
My assistant wants to bend over backwards for the Citadel races. He wants to show them we're reasonable!
No race will respect us until we show them who's in charge! That's what it took with the turians. Forget my assistant.
Like I already told you, after this deal is done, I'll get treatment.
It might look that way from the outside, but this is just a one-time slip-up.
All the top negotiators are on stimulants close to the legal limit. It's the way the game is played.
Maybe you're right. I've been trying to keep humanity strong, and maybe I've pushed myself too hard.
You should put some trust in your assistant. Didn't you train him?
We need to talk about your drug addiction again.
Keeler, you've got a problem. You need to get treatment.
Will overdosing on stimulants and getting arrested help humanity, Keeler?
I don't see all the top negotiators soliciting help to go over the legal limit, Keeler.
You won't be doing humanity any favors if you overdose during negotiations. Get help now.
No trade negotiation is worth ruining your life for. Let it go and get help.
There's no shame in having a problem, but you have to get treatment.
That sounds like an addict talking, Keeler. What does it take to convince you?
Getting you your drug fix isn't high on my list of priorities, Keeler.
You're an addict and a bigot. Your assistant will do a better job. You need to get help.
This deal is too important to have a drug addict negotiating it. You need to get help.
Humanity doesn't need drug addicts negotiating important deals. Get some rest.
Let's discuss your problem.
You're an addict.
Have a little faith.
I'm sure it will be fine.
If you say so.
Don't be an idiot.
Then the game is wrong.
No. You'll go now.
You'll be okay.
Get treatment.
Listen to yourself.
I couldn't risk it.
Sorry, Keeler.
Yeah, what is it?
Doran didn't have a clue what I was doing. He assumed I was cheating.
Either you're cheating or you're not.
I was just tipping the scales in my favor. Only as an experiment.
To you, maybe. But this device is merely intended to simulate situations and record results.
Recording losses is easy, of course. Nobody notices those.
Mmh.
Why were you tossed out of there?
Seems the owner didn't like the way you played their games.
It still sounds like cheating to me.
You cheated?
I'm getting to it.
Here you go. I hope it's what you're looking for.
Actually, I gave your device to Doran.
Gave it away.
Soon.
It's gone.
Ah, change your mind? Are you going to help me record those wins?
You again. What do you want now?
Hey. The system is a big success.
Many thanks.
[sigh] What am I going to do now?
I'm ruined. Ruined!
Excellent indeed. This will provide me with invaluable data.
You enjoy those winnings. I'm going to get this system completed.
But that was years of work. What am I going to do now?
Maybe you should put your talents to better use.
You're no help at all.
This is absolutely the worst day of my life.
Doran caught me cheating and took it from me.
I lost it.
Doran found out.
Well, don't wait forever.
So, did you record five wins with the device yet?
You were cheating, though, weren't you?
I know Doran. If he says you're cheating, you're cheating.
But you were cheating, were you not?
And yet here you are, cheater.
Ah, now you're getting to the heart of it.
I've spent the last five years developing a system that can accurately predict wins and losses on the quasar.
I just need a few more recorded wins and I can complete the algorithms.
It's illegal to use my system. But I won't use it, I'll sell it to others.
Hmm. I suppose I could let you try it.
I just need a few more wins recorded.
Of course, if you get caught with the device, well, you saw what happened to me.
Here you go. When you've recorded enough wins, it will let you know.
Well, off you go. That data won't collect itself.
Hmph. Suit yourself. Well, I have some calculations to do. Goodbye.
Keep your winnings. That should be payment enough, I think.
The device is set to emit a frequency that will slightly increase your odds.
Nothing like my system eventually will, but enough to allow you to record your wins more quickly.
What? No. This device is archaic. It uses brute force to achieve its goal. Besides, you saw how easily it was detected.
My system, when it's complete, will be far more efficient and completely undetectable.
Get a job.
You could put your talents to better use.
You are smart. Apply yourself.
Why do you need to record these outcomes?
Can you do that? Isn't that illegal?
Maybe I could get you the proof you need.
I'll help you out.
I think I'll take my chances, the old-fashioned way.
What's in this for me?
